prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1153; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Vehicle presented after a side impact at an intersection. Damage is concentrated on the driver-side door panel, rear quarter panel and adjacent sill, with the impact pattern consistent with the account given. Repair plan calls for door replacement, quarter panel repair and refinishing, plus sill and trim reattachment. Labor hours submitted are in line with the damage found. Shop billing shows no repeated charges for the same operations. Inspection found no sign of earlier damage to these panels, and no prior loss on this vehicle is known to us. Recommend approval of the repair as presented.
